messages.en:
Hey, thanks for having me
over! I'm including a small
token of my gratitude!
Enjoy!
messages.et:
Hei, aitäh, et lasid mul
külla tulla! Panen kaasa
väikese tänumärgi!
Naudi!

messages.en:
When I saw your pad, it
really needed something.
And then it came to me!
This is what it needed!
messages.et:
Kui su hurtsikut nägin,
vajas see tõesti midagi.
Ja siis see tuli mulle!
Seda ta vajaski!

messages.en:
Your house smelled really 
good. So I'm including
something that smells...
just like me.
messages.et:
Su maja lõhnas tõesti 
hästi. Nii et panen kaasa
midagi, mis lõhnab...
täpselt nagu mina.
